judge.rationale: The candidate halted after writing the initial failing test and Definition of Done without implementing the fix itself. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is completely untouched, so `beforeSession` remains outside the `try` block and the newly added test fails. Furthermore, `CHANGELOG.md` was not updated, and the edit to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` left the old out-of-scope flaw statement intact while attaching a contradictory validation link to it. The test was also placed in a standalone file (`beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts`) rather than alongside the existing hook tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
